modules.title: Coronal ray propagation and line-of-sight sampling
modules.expensive_path: Repeated RK4 ray integration and trilinear sampling across image pixels and recorded ray positions; CPU and CuPy implementations share the same physical data flow.
modules.rationale: Ray propagation determines the paths on which coronal plasma is sampled. Keep these coupled stages together because gpu_raytrace.py implements both, with coordinate and GRFF voxel preparation helpers defining their physical output conventions.
excluded: GRFF radiation transfer, whose implementation is an external shared library
MAS model files and observational data, which are absent from the upstream Git tree
Publication plotting and full emission-map workflow drivers
hazards: The upstream tree has no license file or license declaration
The official CPU/CUDA parity test fails in the supplied lwa environment
Official unit tests do not directly exercise RK4 propagation or cross-section evolution
Runtime imports require more dependencies than the numpy-only pyproject.toml declaration
An existing CuPy implementation is included and must be considered when defining a later acceleration task
modules.purpose: Propagate rays, sample plasma fields and prepare observer-directed voxel inputs.
primary_inputs: Ray launch positions, directions, frequency and integration settings
primary_outputs: Sampled plasma, path lengths and validity mask
unique_responsibilities: CPU and CuPy propagation and sampling
modules.differences: Only proposed module; external emission synthesis consumes its samples and is deferred.
